worked_solution:
The numerator and denominator are $u(x)={x}^{2}$ and $v(x)=x+1,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{u}^{′}(x) & =2x, \\ {v}^{′}(x) & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2x\cdot (x+1)-{x}^{2}\cdot 1}{{(x+1)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2{x}^{2}+2x-{x}^{2}}{{(x+1)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}+2x}{(x+1)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
